def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    # The covered pattern is recovered by 180-degree symmetry around the
    # center of the underlying 32-by-32 pattern.
    out = []
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        src_r = 31 - r
        row = []
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            src_c = 31 - c
            # The input is clipped at its right edge; continue the reflected
            # strip from the last available columns.
            src_c = min(src_c, w - 1)
            row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
